title: VASR: Vector-Aware Assembly Planning with Equivalent Structures and Repair-Cost Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.20984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Furniture assembly planning requires inferring subassembly hierarchies from individual parts and a target illustration. Existing raster-based methods do not explicitly exploit the geometric and structural information in SVG drawings. We introduce VASR, a framework that fuses features from a dedicated SVG encoder with visual representations from a pretrained vision-language model to predict assembly hierarchies. To avoid penalizing valid alternatives to a reference assembly tree, we propose Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization (RHPO) with hierarchy-preserving equivalence rewards. RHPO further uses repair-cost feedback to favor decisions with lower downstream correction costs among candidates with comparable equivalence-aware rewards. VASR achieves the highest Equivalent-Hard F1 among the evaluated methods, outperforming GPT6-Astra by 17.69 percentage points on the IKEA-derived test set while maintaining strong performance on an i

translated_title: VASR：基于等价结构与修复成本反馈的向量感知装配规划
translated_abstract: 家具装配规划需要从单个零件和目标图示中推断出子装配层级结构。现有的基于栅格的方法未能显式利用SVG图纸中的几何和结构信息。我们提出了VASR，这是一个将专用SVG编码器提取的特征与预训练视觉语言模型的视觉表示相融合的框架，用于预测装配层级结构。为避免对参考装配树的有效替代方案进行惩罚，我们提出了修复感知层级策略优化（RHPO），并采用保持层级的等价奖励。RHPO进一步利用修复成本反馈，在等价感知奖励相近的候选方案中，倾向于选择下游修正成本更低的决策。VASR在所有被评估的方法中取得了最高的Equivalent-Hard F1分数，在基于IKEA的测试集上比GPT6-Astra高出17.69个百分点，同时在i（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: VASR框架通过融合SVG向量编码器与视觉语言模型的特征，并采用带层级等价奖励和修复成本反馈的RHPO策略优化方法，在家具装配层级规划任务中显著超越了现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: VASR fuses SVG vector encoder features with vision-language model representations and employs Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization (RHPO) with hierarchy-preserving equivalence rewards and repair-cost feedback, achieving state-of-the-art performance in furniture assembly planning.
